sharedAddition: Top-level Date.now captures start in all modes but only native diagnostic functions read it; checker/JS emitter bodies and outputs unchanged. No profiler flags applied to previous source/JS; scoped prior semantic evidence only.
profileStates: PROFILE_MISSING: deadline or exit without file
PROFILE_INVALID: file cannot be parsed/has no samples
limitations: Long synchronous definition/postwork or profiler dump may exceed remaining5seconds; SIGKILL may leave no profile. heapUsedProxy/RSS are boundary observations, not allocation timeline/peak.
